text:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: alert: sudden spike in 502/gateway timeouts in na-west1b (hosted-api-prod). 502 rate ~12% over last 6m, auth retries increasing. link: https://grafana.company/alert/289123
sophia: getting high-priority customer tickets — some see 401 then 502 on retry. can we confirm it's network not auth layer? @network-ops?
matt: I can repro via curl from our health-checkers — intermittent TCP RSTs and packet loss to na-west1b edge. running a quick traceroute and tcpdump.
matt:
```
# traceroute -n na-west1b-gw
1 10.0.0.1 1 ms
2 52.111.2.4 5 ms
3 203.0.113.45 42 ms
4 * * *
5 198.51.100.9 85 ms  (AS64500 -> AS701)
```

matt: tcpdump shows repeated retransmits and dup acks between our edge and provider peer. Loss ~3-6% in bursts.
network-ops: we see BGP flaps reported from PEER-203 toward our na-west1b circuit starting ~2891234300. opened ticket with provider (case# 9821). they're acknowledging intermittent egress path oscillation.
oliver: routing fallback to na-west1a and na-west1c ready. Can we shift traffic for hosted-api-prod routes? this will add ~20ms p90 but should reduce 502s.
sophia: do it. apply routing policy, then reduce aggressive client-side retry to avoid auth/state churn. @matt can you roll the gateway fallback? :thumbsup:
matt: applying route policy now via control-plane: `route-policy set hosted-api-prod prefer na-west1a if latency <100ms else na-west1b`. also toggling prefix-order to prefer healthy paths. initiating canary shift (5% -> 25% -> 100%).
jay-support: heads-up — enterprise account "AcmePay" submitted an urgent ticket claiming repeated failures and billing errors during retries. Escalation opened with CS; they want mitigation ETA.
oliver: started gateway canary. also enabling short-circuit auth cache for tokens to avoid hitting auth cluster on retries.
network-ops: provider confirmed partial mitigation; they've filtered the unstable path and are rerouting via alternate backbone. still seeing microbursts for ~10m. ETA for stable is 20-30m.
matt: observed 502 rate drop to ~4% after shifting 40% traffic to na-west1a. latency p95 up from 65ms -> 110ms for those routed; customers seeing successful responses now.
sophia: good. action summary: 1) emergency route shift (matt/oliver) 2) reduced retries and enabled auth cache (oliver) 3) provider ticket active (network-ops) 4) CS notified and refund path being reviewed (jay-support).
jay-support: sending templated customer update now — DM me if any wording changes. AcmePay is on-call on this.
matt: monitoring — will revert gradual if provider confirms stable. keeping thread open until 502s <1% for 15m.
network-ops: provider just updated: BGP flap dampening applied on their side, should be stable in 12-18m. will update case#9821.
sophia: thanks team. please paste final post-incident notes once stable. :raised_hands:
oliver: quick repro note for postmortem: repeated client retries after short TCP resets caused auth token churn; consider adding backoff jitter and token cache TTL bump for gateways.
matt: observed final metrics: 502 -> 0.7% at 2891234890, RTT normalized. closing in ~9m if no regressions.
deploy-bot: alert cleared for rule hosted-api-prod 502-spike (clear at 2891234895).
